tools.title: Tools
tools.lede: Move books between repos and back up the voice catalog. Files live next to syntrivetts.db.
tools.upload_hint: Put a .db export or a .sql voice backup from another machine next to this repo's database.
tools.backup_hint: Write the reference-voice catalog to a new .sql file next to the database.
tools.kind_export_text: Books and their jobs (settings, chapters, cast), optionally the whole voice catalog. Rows only: copy each PROCESSING- folder separately.
tools.kind_backup_text: Only the reference-voice catalog, portable paths only. Restore is append-only: an existing id stops it, nothing is overwritten.
tools.ledger_empty: No export or backup files yet. Export books, back up voices, or upload a file from another machine.
tools.export_no_books: This repo has no books to export yet.
tools.export_rows_only: The file holds database rows only. Copy each job's PROCESSING- folder to the other machine separately.
tools.include_voices: Include the whole voice catalog (so the cast keeps its voices on the other machine)
tools.export_nothing: Select at least one job to export.
tools.import_summary: {books} books · {jobs} jobs in the file · {conflicts} already exist in this repo (same book and folder).
tools.overwrite_note: Overwrite deletes this repo's job and re-creates it from the file. If another tool is working on that job, the import is refused (with Unlock) and nothing changes.
tools.import_nothing: Select at least one job to import.
tools.import_bad_form: The import form could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
tools.restore_note: Append-only: a voice id that already exists in this repo stops the restore and nothing is changed.
tools.restore_collision: {name} could not be restored: some of its voice ids already exist in this repo. Nothing was changed.
tools.file_bad_kind: Only .db exports and .sql voice backups are handled here: {name}
tools.file_live_db: The repo's own syntrivetts.db cannot be used here.
tools.file_not_found: No such file next to the database: {name}
tools.file_not_sqlite: {name} is not an SQLite database file.
tools.file_not_text: {name} is not a UTF-8 text file.
tools.file_unreadable: {name} cannot be read as an export file: {error}
tools.notice_exported: Exported {b} jobs to {a} ({c} voices included). Copy each job's PROCESSING- folder too.
tools.notice_backup: Backed up {b} voices to {a} ({c} with machine-specific paths were left out).
tools.notice_imported: Imported: {a} added, {b} overwritten, {c} skipped. Copy their PROCESSING- folders into this repo if you have not yet.
